description: Emergency Fund Calculator with a chart, the same math as the web page. How much should you keep for emergencies? An emergency fund is cash for surprise bills or a loss of pay. See your goal and how long it takes. It multiplies your monthly costs by the months you pick. Then it counts the months to save that much at your pace. It does not pick the right size for you. There is no one right number. People ask for it as "emergency fund calculator", "how much emergency fund should i have" or "how much should i have in an emergency fund".

apy.description: Savings rate (APY). A percent: 5 means 5%. Your account’s rate. 0 leaves interest out. Default: 0.

costs.description: Must-pay costs each month. US dollars. Rent, food, power, insurance, debt payments Default: 3200.

income.description: Money still coming in each month. US dollars. A partner’s pay or jobless benefits Default: 0.

months.description: Months to cover. In months. Default: 3.

perMonth.description: You save each month. US dollars. Default: 400.

saved.description: Saved so far. US dollars. Default: 1500.
